channel.title: The Luverne Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Luverne Journal (luvernejournal.com)

item.title: Crenshaw County Arrests Feb. 9 - 14
item.description: Crenshaw County reports arrests from Feb. 9 – 14, detailing suspects and charges including drug offenses, burglary, domestic violence, harassment and failure to appear.

item.title: Beacon Children's Hospital names new CEO
item.description: Beacon Children’s Hospital has appointed nursing leader Beverly Toney as CEO, bringing over 20 years of healthcare experience to guide its Luverne child and adolescent services.

item.title: Coops endorse Allen for lieutenant governor
item.description: Electric Cooperatives of Alabama PAC backs Secretary of State Wes Allen for lieutenant governor, citing his co-op ties, rural focus and record on business rules, spending and election security.

item.title: What's Happening in Crenshaw County
item.description: Upcoming Crenshaw County events: library programs for kids and adults, NAACP Founders Day dinner, Swamp Supper, farm workshops, AA meetings and more community activities.

item.title: Faith Community Calendar
item.description: Upcoming Luverne faith events: Man Church Feb. 27, first responder breakfast March 7, food pantry March 21, missions meeting April 10, appreciation dinner April 16.

item.title: Crenshaw County teams advance to championship play
item.description: Highland Home girls plus Luverne and Brantley boys clinch regional wins in Montgomery, sending three Crenshaw County teams to next week's AHSAA state finals.

item.title: Miss, Little Miss contestants take 'Big Apple' stage
item.description: Crenshaw Christian Academy brings “New York, New York” to its 2026 Little Miss and Miss CCA pageant Feb. 28, featuring K3 – 12 contestants and a $10 Big Apple–themed evening.

item.title: Tax-free weekend prepares residents for severe weather
item.description: Alabama’s Severe Weather Preparedness Tax Holiday runs Feb. 20 – 22, offering state tax-free purchases of approved severe weather supplies and generators ahead of spring tornado season.

item.title: Kiwanians learn master gardener tips
item.description: Luverne Kiwanians get home yard cultivation advice and learn how to become master gardeners during Feb. 17 meeting at The Chicken Shack.

item.title: Brantley School hosts Bulldog 5K
item.description: Brantley School to host first Bulldog 5K run/walk Feb. 21 to support its track and field program; race starts 9 a.m. after 8-8:30 a.m. registration at the school.
